name: Run Windows Update Troubleshooter
description: Opens the Windows Update troubleshooter to help fix issues with downloading, installing, or completing updates.

description_i18n.en: Opens the Windows Update troubleshooter to help fix issues with downloading, installing, or completing updates.
description_i18n.de: Öffnet den Problembehandlungsdienst für Windows-Updates zur Behebung von Problemen beim Herunterladen oder Installieren von Updates.
description_i18n.fr: Ouvre l'outil de résolution des problèmes pour Windows Update afin d'aider à corriger les erreurs lors du téléchargement ou de l'installation.

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Launches the built-in Troubleshoot settings page via ms-settings:troubleshooter If that fails, it opens general Settings to navigate manually
